verdict.rationale: Paxos documents rule-based orchestrations that trigger automatically when bank transfers arrive (fiat-to-stablecoin mint). Its payments flow can also auto-convert received stablecoin to fiat, so funds move in the background without manual action. These automations are narrow, predefined money-movement flows rather than general user-defined background automations. Missing for 10: general-purpose or custom automation rules, recurring/scheduled automations, broader trigger/action coverage beyond mint/redeem/payment conversion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: This powerful feature enables seamless fiat-to-crypto conversions through rule-based orchestrations that trigger upon receiving bank transfers.
Automatically convert the stablecoin to fiat, or opt to hold balances in stablecoin.
